authority.department: Departamento do Programa Nacional de Imunizações

primary_normative_source.title: Instrução Normativa do Calendário Nacional de Vacinação 2026
primary_normative_source.baseline_role: National normative baseline. Vaccine-specific later DPNI guidance may update or supersede parts of the baseline during 2026.

current_national_calendar.public_presentation_role: Current citizen-facing national calendar; use for presentation cross-check, not as the sole professional rule source.

continuous_update_sources.rule: Later authoritative DPNI technical notes, rectifications and implementation guides must be reviewed for vaccine-specific changes before the engine treats the January baseline as current.

pneumococcal_vpc20_transition.source_title: Guia Técnico para introdução da vacina pneumocócica 20-valente conjugada no PNI

source_precedence.source: Later 2026 DPNI technical note, rectification or implementation guide
source_precedence.scope: Only where it explicitly updates a vaccine-specific rule

source_precedence.source: 2026 Instrução Normativa do Calendário Nacional de Vacinação

source_precedence.scope: Only when explicitly requested and geographically/temporally applicable

durable_boundaries.finding: PNI recommendations can change during the year through technical notes, rectifications and implementation guides.
durable_boundaries.software_rule: Every result must carry an assessment date and source snapshot/effective-rule date. Re-review authoritative 2026 updates before final v2 release.

durable_boundaries.finding: Many PNI recommendations depend on prior doses and whether an age-appropriate series is complete.
durable_boundaries.software_rule: Never generate a definitive due/not-due list from age alone when the official rule requires vaccination history.

durable_boundaries.finding: Unknown vaccination history is not equivalent to a documented zero-dose history.
durable_boundaries.software_rule: Preserve unknown history explicitly and apply only source-supported unknown-history pathways.

durable_boundaries.finding: Routine calendar, seasonal campaigns, rescue strategies and outbreak/blocking actions can have different populations and effective periods.
durable_boundaries.software_rule: Keep routine, campaign/rescue and outbreak recommendations as separate result layers.

durable_boundaries.finding: RIE/CRIE and other special-condition indications are not interchangeable with the routine calendar.
durable_boundaries.software_rule: Never infer special-condition eligibility from age or from an unrelated diagnosis. Require explicit context and identify the special-source pathway.

durable_boundaries.finding: Recommended intervals and minimum exceptional intervals are clinically distinct.
durable_boundaries.software_rule: Never silently substitute minimum intervals for recommended intervals. Label exceptional minimum interval use explicitly.

durable_boundaries.finding: The 2026 pneumococcal schedule underwent a VPC10-to-VPC20 transition beginning midyear.
durable_boundaries.software_rule: Rules must be effective-date aware and preserve historical product/dose information. Do not apply a January-only pneumococcal table to all of 2026.

durable_boundaries.finding: HPV routine vaccination at ages 9–14 is distinct from the 2026 rescue strategy for unvaccinated people ages 15–19.
durable_boundaries.software_rule: Never relabel the time-limited 15–19 rescue strategy as the routine HPV age domain.

durable_boundaries.finding: Influenza routine groups are narrower than the broader groups included in the 2026 seasonal vaccination strategy.
durable_boundaries.software_rule: Present routine eligibility separately from seasonal priority-strategy eligibility.

durable_boundaries.finding: Pregnancy recommendations can depend on gestational age and may repeat each pregnancy.
durable_boundaries.software_rule: Require pregnancy and gestational-week context where applicable; do not infer eligibility from chronological age alone.

durable_boundaries.finding: Some vaccination recommendations are geographic, epidemiologic, outbreak or municipality specific.
durable_boundaries.software_rule: Do not promote local/outbreak recommendations to a generic nationwide routine rule.

durable_boundaries.finding: Vaccination status is a set of vaccine-specific histories and recommendations, not a validated single numerical score.
durable_boundaries.software_rule: Never create a synthetic vaccination-completeness or risk score unless an authoritative source explicitly defines one.
